claims.fact: Rockstar's leadership stated that future games will be developed more quickly, as GTA 6 "is a foundation upon which they can build new content at a faster pace." "The engine, the tools and the team we've built during this project will allow us to do things more quickly," said co-head of development Phil Hooker.
